title: Small business or maker
summary: For small shops and makers: a shop button up top, products with photos and prices, opening hours and where to find you.

notFor: Solo artists selling originals (start from artist)

cards.purpose: Three to nine products with photos and prices.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: Where do people buy from you, and what's new right now?
slots.write: Heading = what's new; first button = their shop (custom, "Visit the shop" or "Order now").

slots.ask: Which three to nine products should be shown? For each: name, price, one detail and a link. You'll upload a photo of each in the editor.
slots.write: tag = price as on their shop; title = product name; description = size or one useful detail.

slots.ask: Can people visit you? When, and where?
slots.write: Hours and address exactly as they give them. A business address only; never a home address unless they say it is the shop.

slots.ask: Do you take wholesale or custom orders? Which address may be public?
slots.write: Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it.

slots.ask: Which social accounts or marketplaces should be linked?
